schema:
CREATE TABLE events (
    seq integer primary key, id text not null unique, at integer not null,
    kind text not null, by text not null, cause text not null, data text not null, process text
  )
CREATE TABLE snapshots (name text primary key, state blob not null)
CREATE INDEX events_cause on events (kind, by, cause)
CREATE TRIGGER events_no_update before update on events begin select raise(abort, 'append-only'); end
CREATE TRIGGER events_no_delete before delete on events begin select raise(abort, 'append-only'); end
CREATE TABLE journal_identity (singleton integer primary key check(singleton = 1), id text)
